_README: Provenance for the vendored Vexa contract fixtures. These files are COPIES from upstream Vexa-ai/vexa at the tag below — never hand-edit them. To refresh: check out the new upstream tag, re-copy the source_paths, update this manifest (tag + commit + seal hashes), and run `pytest tests/contract`. A red test after a refresh is the entire point: it names exactly which upstream change breaks Klai's integration.
_deployed_note: Klai production currently runs 0.10.6.3.14. These fixtures are from the 0.12.22 TARGET. api.v1 is sealed hash-equal across both lines (upstream CI-enforced), so the call-surface tests are valid against production today AND against the migration target.
